facts.text: Pubert is fine, thank you. Do not touch my food. I've seen what happens at this camp.
facts.why: Wednesday has no such line on the quote page. Her mess-hall style line is 'We cannot break bread with you.' She also never frets about Pubert at camp, her worry is Debbie. Printed in quote marks and signed Wednesday Addams.
facts.fix: We cannot break bread with you.

fix_note.text: We cannot break bread with you.

facts.why: The script has no lobster. Debbie is called the black widow, so the dish is renamed after that.

vibe.verdict: Right camp and the right Thanksgiving play, but the writing is a generic mess hall with none of the family's deadpan.
